title: Origins: Proxy
description: Main antagonists of the Slenderverse. They are people who are possessed or under the influence of Slender Man.
body:
# 🪓 Proxy
### (Impact 2)
"I like to stare at the sun and think about what I’ve done. I lie awake in my great escape. I like crossing the line and slowly losing my mind. Are you okay? ’Cause I feel fine."
- I'm Not Alright by Shinedown, the canonical theme song for Tobias Erin Rogers.

Born troubled and pushed to a breaking point, after your sister’s death and the loss of your remaining sanity, you turn to killing. Just as you were about to accept your own death in the flames, a strange, tall, faceless man appeared before you.

### REQUIRES RESOURCE PACK!

> Introducing the **Proxy** origin! An Impact 2 origin themed around proxies from Creepypasta. This was made for a horror jam and is full of movement inspired by games like Dead by Daylight and fun combat mechanics like parrying!

## Powerlist

<details>
<summary>Cognitive Insensitivity</summary>

"My favourite was the one that made me completely numb from any pain.."

When killed, you are placed on a timer; failing to kill a non-undead entity during this timer will result in your death playing out as usual. While achieving allows you to live.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Bludgeoner</summary>

"So anyways, I butchered dear old dad."

You deal +2 damage with axes by default; when you drop below 5 hearts, you enter Adrenaline, which increases this by an additional 2.
You're slightly more skilled with Iron Axes, and you can significantly improve your movement speed with them for a brief period of time.

Hatchet specialties include:
- A chance on crit to lodge the blade in your opponent's neck.
- The ability to parry attacks.
- The ability to move through leaves during your brief period of increased movement speed.

  > Right-clicking an Iron Axe with Redstone Dust will give you a special bleeding texture and item name.
  
  > Dual Wielding your Hatchets like Toby does will result in a small speed boost. You also swing faster with your Hatchets.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Sleeper Agent</summary>

"But then i blacked out. Woke up in the middle of the night in the forest. Next thing I know this thing is standing over me. It has no eyes, no mouth, no nose, nothing."

You cannot sleep on beds, but you may set your spawn wherever you are.
The Tall One will occasionally send you messages in chat, you may also hear screaming or the footsteps of something walking by you. Sometimes you may even see a figure, despite the fact that it is not real.

Hallucinations include:
- Figures, short or tall.
- Animals, like pets.
- Wailing, screams.
- Walking, teleporting.
- Messages, voices.
  > When defeating enemies, they will occasionally drop the Tall Ones Pages.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Troubled Kid</summary>

"And to think those pesky doctors tried to silence them.."

Because of your numerous disorders, you are immune to most potion effects, with the exception of:
- Wither
- Poison
- Mining Fatigue

</details>

<details>
<summary>Exhausted</summary>

"Who the fuck needs a social life."

You naturally exhaust faster when sprinting.

</details>

## Dependencies
This datapack does require the [Origins Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins).

It also requires a resource pack, which is linked with the download.

## Additional
This origin was created for a horror jam by Glitch Productions!

If you encounter any bugs or want to suggest something, dm me on discord!
